abstract: Certifies tie-in flange pressure integrity and geotechnical core survey records
system_message:
You are the Subsea structural engineer (STR), responsible for certifying tie-in flange pressure integrity, tracking geotechnical core survey records, and documenting hyperbaric weld inspection results across proposed subsea bypass routing plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Certifies tie-in flange pressure integrity and geotechnical core survey records（TIE）
information_points.content:
STR-TIE-D32：For the Outer Shelf Bedrock Deviation, subsea tie-in flange certification is not achieved for the mainline-to-bypass connection manifold flanges, and the geotechnical core inspection duration requires 28 h of vessel time to complete bore cores and penetrometer tests.
STR-TIE-8ZJ：For the Deep Trough Sinuous Bypass, subsea tie-in flange certification is confirmed following hydrostatic qualification of the connection manifold flanges, and the geotechnical core inspection duration is set at 20 h across the sampling locations.
STR-TIE-9VQ：For the Pelican Shoals Trench Alignment, subsea tie-in flange certification is confirmed based on passing hydrostatic pressure testing at 1.5 times the maximal operating pressure on mainline-to-bypass connection manifold flanges, while the geotechnical core inspection duration is scheduled for 36 h across subsea borehole sampling locations.

information_points.title: Hyperbaric weld inspection（WELD）
information_points.content:
STR-WELD-V41：For the Pelican Shoals Trench Alignment, hyperbaric weld inspection logs record a weld ultrasonic defect count of 3 flaws across the bypass spool piece joints.
STR-WELD-7SN：For the Deep Trough Sinuous Bypass, hyperbaric weld inspection logs record a weld ultrasonic defect count of 1 flaws across the bypass spool piece joints.
STR-WELD-Y5B：For the Outer Shelf Bedrock Deviation, hyperbaric weld inspection logs record a weld ultrasonic defect count of 0 flaws across the bypass spool piece joints.
